physics.waves-properties-explain-kb.0012.a: Doppler effect: source moves towards observer so wavefronts bunched in front; wavelength shorter; frequency observed higher (speed same)

physics.waves-properties-recall-kb.0001.all: Longitudinal: sound (or P-waves); transverse: light/water waves/EM/S-waves
